name: Dimitrios Katsaros
bio:
Dimitrios's journey to the world of motorsport began unconventionally, through a passion for organizational psychology and a fascination with the high-pressure environment of racing teams. After completing his degree in Human Resources Management, he initially worked in the tech sector, but the allure of Formula 1 and endurance racing proved too strong. He took a significant pay cut to join a small racing team as a junior HR assistant, quickly proving his worth with innovative talent acquisition strategies.

At Reiza Studios Factory, Dimitrios is known for his ability to identify and nurture talent, fostering a collaborative and performance-driven culture. He believes in empowering employees and providing them with the resources they need to thrive. His focus on employee well-being and career development makes him a highly valued member of the management team. Dimitrios is not your typical HR manager, he is proactive, always seeking to improve the performance of the team through human resource development.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted to the left with a slight wave.
physical.description: Dimitrios is of average height, with a lean build, and often seen with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down employee feedback or ideas.
Has a collection of vintage racing posters in his office.
Starts every Monday with a team-building activity, no matter how small.
